description: This file defines the 'Subscription' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension for reporting subscriptions. It manages the display, saving, and retrieval of subscription report data, handling HTTP requests, permissions, and view rendering.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class managing subscription reports in the OpenCart admin area, providing methods to display report pages, save settings, and generate report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up the subscription report page, loads language, sets breadcrumbs, and renders the subscription report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report subscription settings, checking permissions, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the subscription report view with current report data and statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the report list view, essentially a shortcut to get report data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and constructs the subscription report data based on filters, handling pagination, and returning the HTML view for the report list.
